## 2026-09-19 вЂ” TDA T1: the gateway transform, and the matching rule the plan lacked

- `provider/gateway/tda.ts` (new): `applyTemporaryDataAcquisition(body, set, turn)`. The gateway WITHHOLDS, never supplies вЂ” only this layer sees the true outgoing body, and re-attaching from here would mean holding image bytes (plan В§0.1). Four rules: withhold a released/expired item в†’ a pointer reusing the dropped-result grammar (`REPLAY_DELIVERED_MARKER` **imported**, not copied, so `isReplayReduced` recognises both) В· keep a held item untouched В· **NEVER BLANK** (no address в‡’ no replacement вЂ” the invariant the `recall` `keep` defect bought) В· no-op on an empty set or an unparsable body, returning the INPUT STRING rather than a re-serialisation, because that byte-identity is what makes T2's flag-off control meaningful.
- **Decision the plan did not have (now В§0.2.1): matching is CONTENT-ADDRESSED.** An `image_url` entry is `{type, image_url:{url}}` вЂ” the body carries NO part id, so the payload itself is the only handle: `TdaHeld.digest` + an exported `payloadDigest` (ONE implementation, shared with the acquirer; two would drift invisibly and surface as an item that can never be released). The `[Image N]` ordinal was rejected вЂ” it couples this layer to the open numbering decision (В§4.1) and breaks for label-less items (a CUA frame, a document, a stored source). `TdaHeld.reader` is declared by the runtime: the pointer must not name a reader it cannot promise, which is exactly the lie the placeholder shipped once.
- Media shape grounded without guessing: `test/provider/deepseek-image.test.ts` captures a REAL request body from the installed SDK and asserts `content[]` holds `{type:"image_url", image_url:{url:"data:image/webp;base64,вЂ¦"}}`. The T1 fixture reproduces that.
- **My own error, corrected in place:** I attributed the absence of media in `raw-wire/` to AGE (25 image parts ~5.3 h older than the earliest capture) and wrote it into the test doc, plan В§0.6-5 and a commit BEFORE reading `_progress_log.md`. The record refutes it: `@ai-sdk/deepseek@3.0.26`'s converter was text-only вЂ” non-text parts went to `warnings`, never serialized (В«183 raw-wire bodies scanned: zero image partsВ») вЂ” fixed by the 3.0.48 bump. **Two timestamps are not a cause.** This is the third instance of the reflex already named in memory (unexplained state в†’ plausible external cause), and the instrument was one read away.
- Oracle [Exact]: `bun typecheck` exit 0 В· `test/provider/gateway-tda.test.ts` **8 pass / 0 fail / 25 expect** вЂ” withhold В· keep В· blank-guard В· unparsable no-op В· untouched-body byte-identity В· digest stability across mime wrappers.
- Cost shape: flag-OFF is exactly ZERO (short-circuit returns the input); with something released it is one `JSON.parse` + `JSON.stringify` (the shape the reasoning rewrite already pays) plus one sha256 per `data:` payload. The NUMBER belongs to T2, on the real hot path.
- Residual: T2 (wire into `wrapFetch` beside `rewriteReasoningContent`; flag-off byte-identity) В· T3 (the set's write path: acquire/hold/release/expire) В· T4 (the flag, default OFF, every limit a number in `gateway.jsonc`) В· T5 (sandbox: separate build, `opencode/big-pickle`, **must carry an image inside the run**) В· T6вЂ“T8.

## 2026-09-19 вЂ” TDA T2: the transform is ON THE WIRE; the absence of the header IS the flag

- `adaptive-client.ts`: the transform runs inside `wrapFetch`, AFTER `rewriteReasoningContent` (so it sees the body that actually goes out), gated only on the runtime declaring a set in `x-opencode-tda`. The header is CONSUMED and deleted like the credential headers вЂ” it has been folded into the body, and an instruction the provider can read is noise at best.
- `tda.ts` вЂ” `parseTdaHeader(value)`: ONE pure parser, and every failure answers `undefined` (no header В· malformed JSON В· wrong shape В· nothing held В· items failing the shape guard), i.e. "nothing is held". On the hot path of every request an unreadable instruction must neither throw nor half-apply. `turn` travels WITH the set: only the runtime knows which turn the outgoing request belongs to.
- **Plan refinement вЂ” it removes a surface:** the GATEWAY needs no flag. It withholds only when handed a set, so `gateway.tda.enabled` belongs to the RUNTIME's config and T4 becomes "the runtime reads the flag and sends the header": one authority for the switch instead of two, and the zero-cost short-circuit holds whenever nothing is held.
- Oracle [Exact]: `bun typecheck` exit 0 В· `test/provider/gateway-tda-wire.test.ts` **5 pass / 0 fail / 17 expect** вЂ” withheld on the wire with the pointer in place and its neighbours untouched В· byte-identical with no header В· a held item untouched В· a body carrying a different payload untouched В· five malformed headers degrade to nothing В· the instruction is not forwarded upstream (with a forwarded header as control) В· `test/provider/gateway-tda.test.ts` 8/0/25 (T1 intact) В· `test/provider/adaptive-client.test.ts` 4/0/35 (the gateway sibling, unchanged вЂ” the wiring broke nothing).
- Method note: the wire suite deliberately uses a model that does NOT match `/z-ai\/|glm|deepseek/i`, because that regex routes the body through `rewriteReasoningContent`, which re-serialises the JSON and would mask a real difference. Isolating the variable is what makes "byte-identical" mean anything.
- Residual: T3 (the set's write path вЂ” acquire/hold/release/expire, every В§0.9 limit a number in config) В· T4 (the runtime flag, default OFF) В· T5 (sandbox: separate build, `opencode/big-pickle`, **must carry an image INSIDE the run**) В· T6вЂ“T8.

## 2026-09-19 вЂ” TDA T3a: the set's rules, pure and pinned; and two groundings that bound the feature

- `session/acquired-item.ts` (new, **PURE**): `acquiredItem()` computes the digest from the payload url вЂ” so no call site can invent a digest the matcher would not compute, and an item that can never be matched is an item that can never be released В· `release()` withholds AT ONCE and does NOT rewrite the span В· `tdaHeaderValue()` carries the items plus the turn they are judged at.
- **`isWithheld` is exported from the CONTRACT module and BOTH sides call it.** The runtime decides what to send and the gateway decides what to replace, so they must agree BY CONSTRUCTION, not by review: two implementations would disagree invisibly.
- **Release and expiry are TWO facts, now two fields.** The plan's own words are "a released or expired item"; writing a release as "the expiry moved into the past" would blur a decision into a coincidence. `TdaHeld.released?: boolean` added; `isWithheld = released || expiresAtTurn < turn`.
- Turn source, settled by grounding: **a turn is a USER PROMPT**, counted from the session's own event log вЂ” `session_entry.type = 'user'`, indexed by `(session_id, type)` вЂ” so the count is DERIVED, survives a restart, and costs no per-turn write.
- **BOUND 1 вЂ” the header's reach.** `x-opencode-*` go EXCLUSIVELY to opencode-owned providers (`session/llm.ts:959-966`, three-layer contract 2026-09-08: В«third-party providers react badly to foreign namespaced headersВ»). So TDA is INERT on deepseek-direct / novita / openrouter вЂ” a boundary, not a defect to route around вЂ” and it makes the sandbox's `opencode/big-pickle` choice load-bearing for OBSERVATION, not only for cost.
- **BOUND 2 вЂ” the plan's own claim was half-true.** `x-opencode-has-attachments` occurs exactly ONCE in src and it is the READER; there is no writer, so `hasAttachments` is permanently false. "`x-opencode-tda`, beside has-attachments" therefore describes a surface that must be CREATED, not joined. Plan В§0.3 corrected.
- **Tooling falsifier, third instance:** `multiedit` reported В«No changes to apply: oldString and newString are identicalВ» while having APPLIED three of four edits вЂ” including a mangled body (`!releaseal(item)` / `released.set(...)`) that broke the transform. It was caught because the file was RE-READ before the repair and the next oracle would have failed. **Believe the file, not the report** вЂ” already in memory, and still worth re-learning.
- Oracle [Exact]: `bun typecheck` exit 0 В· `test/session/acquired-item.test.ts` **5 pass / 0 fail / 23 expect** В· `test/provider/gateway-tda.test.ts` 9/0/26 (+1: a released item is withheld though its span has not passed) В· `test/provider/gateway-tda-wire.test.ts` 5/0/17.
- Note: LSP flagged `session/llm.ts:604` В«Type instantiation is excessively deep and possibly infiniteВ» while the session folder was touched; `tsgo --noEmit` exits 0, so it is plugin strictness (the class of the ten floating `slog.*`), not a build error вЂ” recorded, not ignored.
- Residual: **T3b** вЂ” the `acquired_item` table (DDL in `storage/db.ts` + the drizzle schema; the DDL is idempotent at open, so existing DBs self-heal), the turn counter, and the header at the send site. Then T4 (the runtime flag, default OFF), T5 (sandbox), T6вЂ“T8.

## 2026-09-19 вЂ” TDA T3b: the set became a ROW; and four cases of the tool lying

- `acquired_item` (DDL in `storage/db.ts` + the drizzle declaration) and `session/acquired-item-store.ts`: reads/writes, the turn counter, and ONE entry point (`tdaHeaderFor`).

- **The `PartID` brand was carried through the whole chain** (contract в†’ constructor в†’ store в†’ tests) with no cast anywhere in the write path: an item's address IS a part's address, and the brand stops a session or message id from being accepted where a part id is meant. `acquiredItem` brands it once, in the single constructor вЂ” earlier the plan's type had `id: string` and the column had a brand, which is how the chain surfaced it.
- A semantic refinement fell out of the brand: an EMPTY address can no longer be built by the runtime, so rule 3's case is reachable only OFF THE WIRE вЂ” which is exactly why the guard belongs on the transform's side. Recorded in that test.
- **The tool lied four times in this task, and for the first time in the OPPOSITE direction:** `multiedit` reported В«Could not find oldStringВ» while having applied the edits. So the report is evidence in NEITHER direction вЂ” only the file is. Separately, my own error: an edit dropped the `session_id` line from the fixture (my oldString included it, my newString did not) в†’ `NOT NULL constraint failed: session_entry.session_id`, i.e. the oracle caught what my eyes did not.

## 2026-09-19 вЂ” FOUND BY READING THE DATABASE: the turn counter read an EMPTY table, so no span would ever expire

- The owner's aside (В«РµСЃР»Рё РїРѕСЃРјРѕС‚СЂРµС‚СЊ Р±Р°Р·Сѓ С‚Р°Рј РјРѕСЂРµ С‚Р°Р±Р»РёС† СЃ РЅРµРїРѕРЅСЏС‚РЅС‹РјРё С†РµР»СЏРјРёВ») produced an inventory, and the inventory produced a defect: **`session_entry` holds ZERO rows**, and `currentTurn` counted turns from exactly there (`type = 'user'`). A counter pinned at 0 makes `expires_at_turn < turn` never true, so **no span would ever expire** вЂ” true of the already-shipped `acquired_item` AND of the designed TTL, which both stand on this counter.
- Inventory (one SELECT over `sqlite_master` plus counts): `event` 87 548 В· `part` 65 184 В· `message` 15 368 В· `balance_snapshot` 1 757 (grows like a log) В· `todo` 116 В· `project_checkpoint` 47 В· `event_sequence` 26 В· `session` 17 В· `migration` 10 В· `project` 1 В· **and six at zero**: `session_entry`, `media_token_calibration`, `part_embedding`, `permission`, `session_share`, `workspace`.
- **A LIVE SOURCE FOUND AND MEASURED:** `message` вЂ” 15 369 total, **1 577 user**, 13 792 assistant. The role lives INSIDE the json `data` (there is no role column), hence `json_extract(data, '$.role') = 'user'`.
- Fixed: `currentTurn` re-based on `message`, and so is its own doc comment, which had asserted the untrue. The store suite's fixture moved from `session_entry` to `message` вЂ” **and that is exactly why the defect survived: the fixture and the code agreed with each other, and neither agreed with the database.**
- Oracles: `bun typecheck` exit 0 В· `acquired-item-store` **4 pass / 0 fail / 17 expect** В· live database: this session counts **335 turns** (0 on the old source), the busiest session 414.
- Lesson: zero rows in a source table reads as "the feature was never used" and actually means "nothing writes the source" в‡’ a mechanism that never fires while staying green. A fixture written by the author cannot see the author's defect. Ask the DATABASE.

## 2026-09-19 вЂ” the ttl field rides in the part's json, and the columns are DERIVED at the write

- The shape is taken from `compacted` rather than invented: the value lives in the json `data`, and the column is a derivative for indexable/queryable loads, produced by the ONE write point (`projectors.ts`, the `PartUpdated` projection).
- `partBase` (`message-v2.ts:100`) is the shared base of EVERY part type, so the two fields go there вЂ” and `PartData`, the type of the json column, is derived from that type, so nothing has to copy them by hand.
- `ttlUntil` is an ABSOLUTE turn, not "turns remaining": a relative value does not say from WHEN, and the reader that has to judge it is the conversion, which sees stored parts long after the tool that made them. Absent means the mechanism does not apply, so "permanent" needs no value of its own.
- The projector derives `ttl_until`/`ttl_scope` from the same `rest` it stores as json, so the two homes of one value stay together because ONE writer owns both вЂ” and it needs no `as any`, because the field is on the base and is therefore typed on every variant.
- Found while grounding: `storage/schema-project.sql.ts` declares these core tables a SECOND time (stale вЂ” its `PartTable` lacks the `type`/`tool_name`/`status` columns migration `20260730` added). Only the uncommitted gateway leg imports that file. Next cleanup candidate, recorded in the database-truth plan.
- Oracle (`test/session/part-ttl-storage.test.ts`, new): undeclared в‡’ NULL on BOTH sides; declared в‡’ present in the json AND the columns; moved в‡’ both move; dropped в‡’ both clear. Plus `bun typecheck` exit 0 and `part-ttl-storage + message-v2` 43 pass / 0 fail / 76 expect.

## 2026-09-19 вЂ” the turn reaches EVERY conversion of session history; and a negative control killed my own justification

- `toolReplayOptions(cfg, afterMessageID, sessionID)` вЂ” the third argument is required and the current turn is derived from the session INSIDE one resolver, not repeated as an expression at every call site that would have to remember it. Both arguments are required on purpose: `undefined` is a DECISION stated at the call, and a site added later cannot inherit "no release" by forgetting. The compiler asks at every one of them.
- EIGHT sites are wired: the three request-assembly branches (which also splice a prefix out of the checkpoint), `captureSummary`'s checkpoint, the two turn-checkpoint saves, and the summary path. The checkpoint paths MUST see the same turn, because a checkpoint has to store what the trunk sends вЂ” one built without it froze full tool outputs the trunk had already collapsed (prefix divergence from message 9, 541_502 tokens recomputed, 2026-09-07). The single deliberate exception is title generation: it names the session's opening messages rather than delivering history to the main model, and runs where no declared span can have passed.
- The compile oracle caught that `captureSummary`'s identifier is `input.sessionID`, not `sessionID` вЂ” a scope error that would otherwise have shipped silently, since a plain name lookup was the only thing distinguishing them.
- **MY JUSTIFICATION ABOUT THE CACHE WAS FALSE, and a negative control is what killed it.** I added a `turn` component to the conversion cache key, claiming that without it "the release would silently never fire". The negative control вЂ” remove the component and re-run вЂ” stayed GREEN, so the claim was false. The reason is structural: a release REWRITES the parts, and the cache fingerprint `contentFp` is taken FROM those parts, so a pre-release entry and a released one cannot share a key at any turn. The component was removed, the comment rewritten to the measured argument, and the test renamed to the property it actually verifies ("a cached pre-release entry is never served after the release").

## 2026-09-19 вЂ” the fold's hard release: the last piece of T6's contract

- At the fold boundary вЂ” the SAME seam as `AcquiredSet.releaseAll` (`prompt.ts`) вЂ” every still-running span is moved into the PAST: `ttlUntil = turn - 1`. **Expired, never un-declared**: clearing the declaration would make the piece PERMANENT again and put its payload straight back on the wire, i.e. the exact opposite of a reset. A value one turn in the past makes the release bite IN THIS TURN rather than the next.
- The reset walks the ALREADY-LOADED window (`visibleAfter`) instead of querying: those parts are in hand, each carries its own declaration, and a piece outside the window is not being sent. So the `(session_id, ttl_until)` index has no reader at this site вЂ” its reader will be the listing of what is holdable (the next unit). Recorded here so the index does not read as forgotten.
- The predicates were extracted to ONE place (`declaredUntil`, `isSpanExpired`, `expiredSpan`, `spansToExpire` in `message-v2.ts`) and are used by BOTH readers вЂ” the wire gate and the fold reset. A one-turn disagreement between them would be invisible on both sides; now the comparison is single by construction.
- The reset RETURNS what it releases and the caller logs count + ids: a release nobody can enumerate is indistinguishable from a loss.
- **Honest residual, recorded rather than hidden:** this turn's summary is captured BEFORE the fold is decided (`captureSidecar` at 2689, `foldDecision` at 2707), so a span still live at that instant appears in it as live; the reset turns it into a pointer from the next request on. The strict reading of В«РІ summary РЅРµ СЃС‡РёС‚Р°РµС‚СЃСЏВ» needs the fold to be known BEFORE the summary is taken вЂ” a re-ordering of the seam, not a two-line change.
- Oracles: `bun typecheck` exit 0 В· `part-ttl-gate + temp-lifetime + recall + part-ttl-storage + message-v2` **74 pass / 0 fail / 175 expect** В· `prompt.test.ts` **42 pass / 13 skip / 0 fail / 169 expect**, exactly the recorded baseline.

## [2026-09-22 22:40] July-ABI imports land, funded entirely by removed prose

Task: pull what is still load-bearing from `opencode_prompts_kernel.txt` (the July BGE-era
ABI), place it by gate, and find the excess prose to pay for it.

Landed in `source.py` вЂ” twelve norms, none of them host-specific:
- G1 `@INSTRUMENT_ORDER` вЂ” try instruments by decisiveness per call; descend only on a
  recorded empty/failure; escalate the whole chain before saying "not found".
- G1 `@LOUD_FAILURE` вЂ” between two instruments prefer the one whose failure is VISIBLE. A
  scanner returns matches and so looks successful while missing dynamic dispatch,
  re-exports and runtime binding. This is the grep-instead-of-codegraph defect stated as a
  norm rather than as a tool preference.
- G1 `@DEVICE_STATE` вЂ” device/hardware state is observed, never recalled; it drifts across
  a fold. (The rule whose absence produced the CPU-pinned embedding run on 2026-09-22.)
- G0 `@STATE_FIRST` вЂ” publish the state before reasoning from it.
- G4 `@CONCRETE_BOUNDS` вЂ” every bound is an integer; a budget that cannot be exceeded
  cannot detect a STALL.
- G7 `@VERIFY_BEFORE_REDUCING`, `@NO_INVENTED_CONSTANTS`, `@ONE_TASK_OPEN`.
- G8 `@SIGNAL_CARDINALITY` вЂ” identical diagnostics from one source are ONE signal.
- `@INFORMATION_STATUS` вЂ” your own recall is the weakest rung and never evidence alone.
- `INTENTION_RESET` вЂ” a persisted criterion never restates this protocol: a rule already in
  the prefix is paid again verbatim in the fold and, once it drifts, competes with the
  original as a second authority (owner, 2026-09-22).
- G6 вЂ” the impact query runs for EVERY mutation binding: whether a surface has other
  consumers is its answer, not its precondition. (The old rule was circular.)

Per host: `INSTRUMENT_CHAIN` names the actual rungs, and the two hosts without a history
search say so instead of skipping the rung silently.

NOT imported, recorded so nobody pulls it "for completeness": that file's `SV_OUTPUT`
contradicts the live kernel вЂ” it wants an 8-32 hex digest DERIVED from the vector, changed
when keywords change, and OMITTED on trivial answers. Ours is 32 hex, never computed from
the vector, and trivial turns carry the trivial instance.

three separate additions); 2 696 B of owner quotes, dated measurements and restatements

and `@MEDOID_SIMPLEX`; a manifest enumeration in `PROJECT_STRUCTURE`; and 249 B from

power. `@PREDICATE_POWER`: "The predicate is part of the instrument: it must separate the
hypothesis from its alternative, not merely return a value. If both branches satisfy it the
oracle has no power and its PASS closes as Unknown."

## [2026-09-24 15:05] Artifact digest вЂ” the pull half of divergence

The outside review's one surviving item. `@DIVERGENCE_PROTOCOL` only ever revoked a stamp when NEW
evidence arrived вЂ” a push. Nothing re-checked a stamp at the moment it was USED, so a stamp read
back after a fold, or reused from a ledger, was trusted however far its artifact had moved since.
G8 `PROVENANCE` wrote the digest "so the decision can be reproduced" and no rule ever compared it
again.

Three changes, one norm:

- `@DIVERGENCE_PROTOCOL` gained the read-back clause: a stamp holds only while the artifact it
  names is unchanged; re-digest before relying on one read back from a ledger, a plan or memory;
  an unequal **or unobtainable** `content_hash` is divergence pulled instead of waited for, and
  the claim reverts to Unknown. "Unobtainable" is what covers a stamp that never recorded a digest
  вЂ” no separate clause needed.
- `ORACLE_STAMP` gained `content_hash?`. Without the SLOT the rule is prose: there was nowhere to
  put the digest and therefore nothing to compare against. Optional because evidence that is not an
  artifact (a live probe) has no stable digest.
- G8 `PROVENANCE` now says why it is written: "so the decision can be reproduced **and the stamp
  revalidated**" вЂ” the write site names its reader.

Collision guarded explicitly: the same kernel forbids computing `@SV_FORMAT.md5` ("a label, not a
checksum"), so the clause states that THIS digest is computed and compared. Same class as the
Unknown/medoid collision fixed on 09-22 вЂ” a new term must be told apart from the one it rhymes with.

**Funded at zero net cost**, per the standing rule (budget comes from prose, not from the ceiling):
`PREDICATE_POWER` and `ORACLE_DISCRIMINATION` were one norm at two granularities вЂ” merged into one
rule keeping all five operative parts (predicate is part of the instrument; separate the hypothesis
from its alternative; power is what a result EXCLUDES; name the alternatives BEFORE designing the
predicate; more than one survivor в†’ Unknown в†’ a more discriminating predicate, not a louder one).
`ORACLE_STAMP_RULE` lost "Divergence revokes a stamp to Unknown", a verbatim restatement of the
shared rule already listed one line above it in the same gate.

Note on the instrument: `dedup.semantic_similarity` did NOT flag that pair (below 0.40) because it
is lexical вЂ” it compares words, not claims. Its silence is not evidence of independence, and the
top of its ranking (`PLAN_CONTRACT_ENFORCEMENT`/`PLAN_BINDING_ENFORCEMENT` 0.504,
`ACTION_CLASS_RULE`/`WRITE_SCOPE` 0.486) is shared VOCABULARY between rules that say different
things. Read the pairs, do not act on the score.

Test moved in the same change, not after it: `test_render.py` pinned the literal
`ORACLE_STAMP: {...EXPECTED_FAIL}` under the K-3 comment. The pin's intent is the three RESULTS,
not a frozen field list вЂ” updated with that reason dated, plus three new pins for the read-back
clause so the norm cannot vanish silently.

106 passed. product 46 820 / 47 000 (sha256 `39516d3eb691d7312f3b8948cd096ff788b761c3f151c3d7afb70e894284dc73`),
claude 46 661 (`644241efa7aeafae370d4d308060e1b209ef13ffe530a28955d254f4d92b077b`), codex artifact
46 185 (`41e979676df35511d2d6ff4e4e3667c7c6c3370314db031bf441b93464752754`). `baseline.json` repinned

## [2026-09-24 21:05] Kernel release вЂ” rebuilt on the battle-tested base

The owner named `dist/2026-09-17_23-16-37_reasoning_prompt.txt` as the artifact with a real project
run behind it. It is byte-identical to `2026-09-16_13-21-05` (sha `f98f0f11вЂ¦`), so the whole earlier
census holds and now rests on the right reference. Everything evicted in this release landed AFTER
that build and carries no run.

Three mechanisms, all measured against it:

1. **Pre-action bloat.** G0+G1 вЂ” the section an agent must read and SATISFY before its first call вЂ”
   went 2 840 в†’ 7 309 B (Г—2.6), a third of G1 being catalogues that help build a surface and never
   help find one. An imperative that is not a call is satisfiable only by prose. Evicted to
   `docs/ui-standards.md`, `ACCEPTANCE_FRAME` moved to G3, G0 reduced to the intention. Now 5 365 B,
   guarded by `test_pre_action_section_stays_small` вЂ” a flat total ceiling cannot see mass moving
   forward in the pass, which is why the regression ran nine days unnoticed.
2. **The chain was a fence.** A closed enumeration of host tools made "instrument" mean "one of
   these", so an agent with no listed tool reached for the most impressive one it could not steer вЂ”
   a 3D interactive environment, or the built application. Owner's field case: he finally told GPT
   "here is the reading module, apply filters, get the array" вЂ” which is exactly what the 09-17
   kernel did unaided. Now: the chain is a ladder, and when no rung answers you BUILD the instrument
   from the project's own parts.
3. **A non-PASS had no forward edge.** `UNKNOWN_ROUTING` sends an Unknown claim forward to G9; the
   map offered only the two back edges. That circle IS the STALL вЂ” the external review called it
   "walking in circles" and was right, though it named the wrong cause. Compounding it,
   `loop_budget` had no value anywhere in the kernel, so the STALL terminal's earliest legal firing
   was the first retry. Fixed: second forward `G8 в†’ G9`, `G9 в†’ WAITING_APPROVAL`, the G8 terminal
   removed, `validate.py` refuses terminals from G7/G8, and the budget defaults to 3.

The owner's loop landed as edges, not prose: `G1 в†’ G2` split into its two senses (grounded on
instrument results OR an established absence / not groundable at this scale вЂ” split until a leaf is
observable) with the return `G2 в†’ G1`; `G8 в†’ G1` for an unrealistic oracle; `G1 в†’ BLOCKED` widened
to "unobservable at every scale". The descent is measured by `FRACTAL_GEOMETRY.scale`, not by the
claim tuple, which RISES when a surface is split вЂ” the slot already existed.

`@ORACLE` is now a definition with five required properties (can fail, right layer, excludes the
alternatives, returns an ADDRESS, and this identity can DRIVE it). The last two are new axes: the
3D-environment case is a failure of DRIVE, the built-exe case a failure of ADDRESS. Core clause kept
verbatim вЂ” the constitution is identical to 09-17, same 8 rules and 8 pinned clauses, verified by
diff. The core held; the periphery bloated, which is what a constitution is for.

`@GUESS_DECIDES_NOTHING` is the first caller `@SOURCE_ROUTING`'s 67 authorities have ever had: the
table was mentioned three times in the whole kernel, twice to CLASSIFY and once to INVENTORY, never
to ENTER.

## [2026-09-24 21:40] loop_budget: the magic number removed, derived from the map instead

Owner flagged the hardcode: "СЂРѕРІРЅРѕ 3 РїРѕРїС‹С‚РєРё РЅР° С†РёРєР»". He was right twice over.

1. **It violated `@NO_INVENTED_CONSTANTS` inside the kernel itself** вЂ” "magic numbers are discovered
   from the host, the index or the project configuration". I wrote 3 from nothing.
2. **It duplicated an existing norm.** `UNKNOWN_ROUTING` already says reaching for the same
   instrument again is a STALL, so for one instrument the budget was always 1. A second authority
   parallel to an existing one is what NO_DUPLICATE_NORM (amendment step 2) forbids.

Replaced by a DERIVED bound: the envelope's value, else **the count of distinct declared routes out
of that gate**, counting DISTINCT attempts. Measured from the graph: G8 has three (G6 repair, G2
re-plan, G1 re-ground), G9 two, G2 and G5 one each. So 3 was accidentally correct for G8 вЂ” as a
consequence of the map, not as a constant, and wrong for every other gate.

Also clarified the no-op charge: "no instrument result (**an established absence counts**)". Without
that clause the rule had a perverse incentive вЂ” a grounding attempt that legitimately comes back
empty would burn a retry, pushing toward premature action, i.e. the opposite failure.

Correction to the owner's reading of the mechanics, on evidence: exhaustion no longer throws the
process into a terminal directly. Since variant B the route is `G8 -> G9` forward and G9 chooses вЂ”
WAITING_APPROVAL with a user present, BLOCKED with a recorded residual and route when autonomous.
The stop still exists; it now passes through closure instead of around it.

## [2026-09-24 22:35] The SierpiЕ„ski test вЂ” proving the stop instead of measuring it

Owner: В«РІР·СЏР»Рё РєРІР°РґСЂР°С‚ вЂ” РґРѕРїРѕР»РЅРёР»Рё СЂР°РІРЅРѕСѓРґР°Р»С‘РЅРЅС‹С… С‚РѕС‡РµРє РїРѕ СЂР°РґРёСѓСЃСѓ вЂ” вЂ¦ РёРёРё РљСЂСѓРі. Р РІРѕС‚ СЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ С‚С‹ СЌС‚РѕС‚
РєСЂСѓРі РЅРµ СЂР°СЃРєР»Р°РґС‹РІР°Р№ вЂ” РѕРЅ РєСЂСѓРіРѕРј Рё Р±СѓРґРµС‚. РЈ РєРѕРІСЂР° РЎРµСЂРїРёРЅСЃРєРѕРіРѕ РІРѕРѕР±С‰Рµ СЌС‚Рѕ РєСЂР°СЃРёРІРѕ РІС‹РіР»СЏРґРёС‚.В»

Two distinct ideas, and the second is the one the rule was missing:

- **The circle** is the LIMIT of refinement: past convergence the shape no longer changes, so further
  splitting cannot add anything. That is the fixed point already landed.
- **The carpet** is the RECOGNITION test: when a split returns the parent's own structure, the gain is
  zero *by construction*, not merely zero *in this one measurement*. That is a proof of the stop
  rather than an observation of it вЂ” the difference between "I split once and gained nothing" and
  "no split can gain".

Landed in `@LOOP_PROGRESS`: "scale alone divides forever, so the measure is the gain: a split
reproducing the parent's structure gains nothing by construction."

Funded by removing "The route out is G1" from G0_SCOPE вЂ” the graph already declares G0 -> G1 as the
only forward edge, so the sentence was a second statement of the map вЂ” and by dropping the condition
restatement from G9 (it now lives once, in @LOOP_PROGRESS).

Also repaired a self-contradiction I had just committed into the release note: one bullet still said
`loop_budget` "defaults to 3" while another said "derived, not hardcoded", and the totals row was
stale. A self-contradicting artifact is worse than a missing one вЂ” it makes the reader arbitrate.

## [2026-09-24 22:55] Perfect form вЂ” completion is two-sided

Owner: В«РњСѓРґСЂРѕСЃС‚СЊ РЅР°РґРѕ РїСЂРѕСЏРІР»СЏС‚СЊ РЅР° СЌС‚Р°РїРµ РїРѕСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРєРё Р·Р°РґР°С‡Рё. Рђ РїРѕС‚РѕРј РЅР°РґРѕ РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РµС‘ РґРѕРґРµР»Р°С‚СЊ С‚Р°Рє,
С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ Р±С‹Р»Рѕ РЅРµС‡РµРіРѕ РґРѕР±Р°РІРёС‚СЊ, РЅРµС‡РµРіРѕ СѓР±Р°РІРёС‚СЊ вЂ” perfect form.В»

Two things came out of that.

**The division of labour maps onto the gates.** Judgment is irreplaceable at G0/G1 вЂ” choosing what
the task IS, and seeing that the user's own diagnosis may be wrong. From G2 to G9 the character is
mechanical: decompose, fill, verify, close. Which is why the pre-action bloat measured earlier today
was harmful twice over: it cluttered the one section where thinking is the work, and pushed prose
into the gates where action is the work.

**The fixed point had only one side.** I had encoded "no split improves the result" вЂ” nothing to ADD.
The other derivative is "nothing present lacks support" вЂ” nothing to REMOVE, which is `CUT_UNSUPPORTED`
at G2, but it was never tied to completion. Perfect form is both at once, and both operations already
existed; the conjunction was missing. G9 `CLOSURE_PROOF_RULE` now reads: "Completion is two-sided: no
split adds, and nothing present lacks support. Record the remainder as residual вЂ” finished, not
abandoned." It is 15 B SHORTER than the one-sided version it replaced.

## [2026-09-24 23:05] form_holds вЂ” the converse, encoded as a slot

Owner: В«Р’РµСЂРЅРѕ Рё РѕР±СЂР°С‚РЅРѕРµ вЂ” Р»СЋР±Р°СЏ РЅРµ perfect form РїРµСЂРµС‡С‘СЂРєРёРІР°РµС‚ Р»СЋР±СѓСЋ РјСѓРґСЂРѕСЃС‚СЊ СЃ С‚РѕС‡РєРё Р·СЂРµРЅРёСЏ
РїСЂРѕРґСѓРєС‚Р°.В»

Value does not ADD, it MULTIPLIES: wisdom Г— form = product, so a zero on the form side zeroes the
product regardless of the thinking behind it. His own field case is the proof вЂ” what enraged the
experts about Astra was not the specification errors but an odometer wheel drawn not pressed against
the pipe wall.

What this exposed in the kernel: today's `@EVIDENCE_BOUNDED_CLOSURE` says a partial REAL result
outranks a complete simulated one, and that is right вЂ” but `RESIDUAL_GOAL` was `{gap, bound, route}`
and said nothing about whether the DELIVERED part stands on its own. A residual can be small and
still lethal to the form, and an autonomous run would report "partial real result" while shipping a
fragment worth zero.

Encoded as `{gap, bound, route, form_holds}` вЂ” a SLOT, 13 bytes, not a sentence. This is today's own
finding applied to itself: a field has to be filled, so it forces the judgement, while an imperative
only requests it and can be satisfied by tone.

Asked for a rebuild; `python build.py` (all steps) could not produce one, and the reasons were two real defects in the builder plus one toolchain blocker вЂ” each measured, none guessed. Commit `f4c65b0367`.
What changed (`build.py`): (1) `step_reasoning` asserted `## 0. KERNEL_MAP`, a heading the kernel renamed to `## 0. WORKFLOW` вЂ” the canon states the first heading IS `## 0. WORKFLOW` (`docs/two-canon-protocol.md:44`), `prompt_kernel/render.py:183` renders it, and the kernel's own tests assert it (`test_render.py:15`, `test_compatibility.py:39`, `test_contracts.py:78`). It failed EVERY full build, at the step right after `kernel` had already written production. (2) `step_opentui` needs a POSIX `sh` (bun runs `sh scripts/prepare-zig-deps.sh`) and Windows has none; the Git for Windows shell is now on PATH for that step вЂ” APPENDED, because prepending made `tar` resolve to Git's GNU tar, which reads the drive-letter root bun hands the script as a REMOTE host (`Cannot connect to D:`).
Oracles: `20260930T041744Z_a081efaf` died on the assert, and `python build.py --only reasoning` answers `OK reasoning kernel` after the fix; `20260930T041858Z_8c08fdfb` (`command not found: sh`); `20260930T042235Z_718c5ca3` (`Cannot connect to D:`); final run `20260930T042548Z_107f8a99` exit 0 вЂ” `dist/bin/opencode.exe` + `opentui.dll` + `opencode-markdownify.exe` staged, and the binary answers version **10.0.1161**.
NOT fixed, named: the native half needs **Zig 0.16** and this host has 0.15.2, so `build.zig:111` fails on `std.Io.Dir`; the `opentui` step cannot complete here. The exe was built from the DLL already in the tree, which IS source-current вЂ” the last commit touching opentui (`26604f2ca4`) changed only a `.gitignore`, which the step's fingerprint counts, so `[REBUILD] opentui` was bookkeeping rather than staleness.
Tool state вЂ” three classes: (a) under cmd_runner `--raw` STALLS `bun run script/build.ts`: 0.11 s of CPU per 20 s of wall, 0 bytes written, `state: running` while the job wrapper already reported `done`; its ConPTY backend completes the same command. (b) `list` returned a STALE snapshot вЂ” `packages/opencode/dist/.../opencode.exe` read as `10:31:32` while the file on disk was `12:26:26`; freshness of a build must be read from the binary (`--version`) or a fresh listing, never from a timestamp remembered minutes earlier. (c) `stage` writes via `write_bytes`, so a copied artifact ALWAYS carries a fresh mtime вЂ” a new timestamp in `dist/bin/` is not evidence of a new build.

What the box asked for вЂ” В«capture its output OUTSIDE the ConPTY rendering (`> file 2>&1` inside the .cmd)В» вЂ” is REFUTED: such a redirect cannot exist, because the `.cmd` stops being executed at the first `bun` call. That explains 2026-09-29 completely: `run2.cmd` is a `.cmd` whose last act is a `bun` call, so `opencode run` never finished a turn вЂ” hence the 181-byte log and the absence of every write, with no crash anywhere. ## [2026-09-30] R2 вЂ” the turn's timings become STATE, on the turn's own part

Plan: `plans/2026-09-30_turn-commit-slot.md` R2 в†’ [x], with `svm set state=verified` and a re-render.
What changed: `StepFinishPart` gains `timing: { requestMs?, commitMs?, commitHash? }` (`session/message-v2.ts`), written by the processor (`session/processor.ts`). The two halves are written at DIFFERENT times, and that is the shape of the box: `requestMs` is known when the part is created, while `commitMs`/`commitHash` can only arrive once the detached commit has settled вЂ” so the part is now written BEFORE the fork and the fiber writes back onto it (`Effect.flatMap` в†’ `updatePart`, failure caught and logged, because a detached fiber has no caller to reach). `commitMs` counts a wait behind a sibling commit; `commitHash` is recorded because its ABSENCE is what a failed or aborted commit looks like in state, instead of the `Effect.catch(вЂ¦ undefined)` that used to end that effect with nothing. The `turn.prepare` log line stays as the live view of the same number; the state is what survives the session.
Oracles: `bun test test/session/turn-timing.test.ts` вЂ” a REAL turn through the real processor against a stub LLM, then the part read back from SQLite: RED before the writer (`20260930T034925Z_bdcd40af`, failing exactly on `typeof timing.requestMs === "number"` with `expect(ended).toBeDefined()` already green) and GREEN after (`20260930T034957Z_2b1f94d8`, 1 pass / 4 expect, both halves, 40-hex hash); **19 pass / 0 fail** over `processor-effect` + `snapshot-tool-race` + `snapshot-granularity` + `turn-timing` (`20260930T035033Z_187d6d85`); `bun typecheck` в†’ exit 0 (`20260930T035139Z_7cde9bdc`). ## [2026-09-30] The stall plan is refuted by measurement, and becomes the commit slot

Plan: `plans/2026-09-30_turn-commit-slot.md` вЂ” born as `plans/2026-09-29_stall-reproducer.md` (untracked), re-grounded in place and renamed; the old file removed. Manifests R1/R2 written, `plans/MASTER_PLAN.md` re-rendered (15 plans, 65 open boxes, the new file named, the old one gone).
What was measured (live, twelve `turn.prepare` lines of this session, 02:33в†’03:30 UTC): `requestMs` 19, 29, 33, 33, 34, 42, 43, 43, 47, 48, 65, 617 ms and `fossilMs` **0 in all twelve** вЂ” against the old plan's acceptance of a 20вЂ“36 s band in at least one of five turns. Its second premise dies with it: the stall was held to be history-dependent, and this session carries more history than 2026-09-29 did while preparing in tens of ms.
The mechanism, from code and then confirmed by that measurement: a turn CLOSES by forking its commit into `turn.job` (`processor.ts:1182`, `forkDetach`) and OPENS by joining it (`:560-564`, which is what `fossilMs` measures), but `endTurn` (`:207-209`) DELETES the record holding `job` and is called in the same turn (`:1313`) AFTER the fork вЂ” so the next `beginTurn` (`:201-205`) always builds a fresh record with `job: undefined`. The join is unreachable on this path, `fossilMs` can only be 0, the commit is never settled in order, the comment's В«linear by constructionВ» is false as written, and two commits may overlap in one worktree.
Left OPEN on purpose: the 2026-09-29 source-run reported `fossilMs 2940/491`, values that exist only inside the `if (turn.job)` branch вЂ” so the join DID run there. How that run differed is not measured, and the plan records the contradiction instead of resolving it by preference. Attribution of the removal is INDETERMINATE (it coincides with `d68243a635` and `75a99e1d18`; no before-run is available and the older session logs are gone).
Tool state: `turn.prepare` is a LOG in a session-scoped file and the 29th's numbers no longer exist, so this plan could not be re-grounded from its own instrument вЂ” hence R2 (the datum has a key, so it is STATE). And a read batched in one block with a write returned the PRE-write state: the map looked un-rendered until it was read again in a separate block.

Plan: `plans/2026-09-29_svm-tool-and-master-plan.md` S6 в†’ [x], with `svm set state=verified` and a re-render.

test/session/summary-block-shape.test.ts test/session/fold-determinism.test.ts test/tool/svm.test.ts` в†’
**33 pass / 0 fail** (`20260930T032653Z_1f9668f8`); LIVE measurement on the REAL repository
(`experiments/2026-09-30_s6-fold-carrier/check.ts`, `20260930T032829Z_3c60c493` then `20260930T032920Z_d099c720`):
the block is a real render (15004 then 14853 bytes, never UNAVAILABLE) naming 15 real plans and 68 then 67 open
boxes, and **m\* ends with it** вЂ” `true` in BOTH runs.
What changed: `SVM.renderFoldBlock(worktree)` renders the map AT fold time through the same `renderBody`; the
compaction head carries it as the LAST block (`masterPlanBlock`, after the recent messages and the closing
pointers); the builder owns the header and prints MISSING when no render was supplied, while `renderFoldBlock`
never throws and prints UNAVAILABLE with its reason.
Enabling, both forced by where the fold runs: `renderBody` is service-free (records read through
`Storage.keyFile`, the store's own mapping) and is no longer an `Effect`, since every input it reads is a plain
file; and the private `storedRecord` became the exported `readRecord(planFile, taskId)` keyed through `taskKey`
вЂ” the enumeration used to compose the same key BESIDE it, a second spelling of one mapping.
Learned: THE SECOND RUN WAS THE BETTER EVIDENCE. After S6's own box closed, the live block diverged from the
file's body (14853 against 15004) вЂ” a carrier that inherited a copy would have matched the file; this one was
fresher than it. Also: the first oracle run was red on a `dir` used outside its `inTmpdir` scope, named exactly
by tsgo (file+line) and by bun вЂ” the cheap half of the oracle working.
TOOL STATE вЂ” `stdout_text.log` under ConPTY printed two of the block's lines JOINED, dropping a blank line the
string-level comparisons still carried (`true`/`true`). Class: the log is a RENDERING of the stream, so it cannot
answer a question about the TEXT. Countermeasure used, and the habit worth keeping: print the tail as JSON
escapes when layout is what is in doubt.

## [2026-10-06] constitution: the enumeration gate reads the HEAD only вЂ” `dir` in a pipeline tail is plumbing
Owner: В«РЅР°РґРѕ РґРёСЂ Р±Р»РѕРєРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РµСЃР»Рё РѕРЅ РІ РЅР°С‡Р°Р»Рµ Рё РїРѕ РїРѕРІРѕРґСѓ РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅС‹С… С„РёС€РµРє РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Рµ Р·Р°РјРµРЅСЏСЋС‚ glob Рё grep С‚РѕР¶РµвЂ¦ РўСѓС‚ Р·Р°РїСЂРµС‚ С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РґРёСЂ РЅРµ РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°Р»СЃСЏ РєР°Рє РіР»РѕР±Р°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ РёСЃРєР°С‚РµР»СЊ вЂ” РїРѕС‚РѕРјСѓ С‡С‚Рѕ СЌС‚Рѕ РІРµС€Р°РµС‚ СЃРёСЃС‚РµРјСѓВ». Reproducer FIRST (`experiments/2026-10-06_constitution-dir-head/probe.ts`, 10 cases Г— 3 paths): the TOKEN path already passed the owner's acceptance command (`shellSegments` does not split on `|`/`&`), while the AST path (`evaluate`, which walks EVERY command node) blocked it вЂ” 4 divergences, all AST, both grammars: the acceptance pipeline and `echo hi & dir`. Pins added to `test/session/constitution-enumeration-probe.test.ts` (В«enumeration gate: HEAD onlyвЂ¦В»): the acceptance pipeline, the three head forms, and the AST agreement WITH a control on the same instrument вЂ” fallibility already on record (the probe's RED run 20261005T025432Z_99e7b95e). Evidence: probe RED в†’ GREEN 30/30 (20261006T025456Z_567c69be); tests 69 pass/0 fail incl. description-integrity (20261006T025607Z_82a5bce8); _build.ps1 (20261006T025617Z_72447493).


## [2026-10-06] constitution: the gate blocks the WALK, never a named QUERY (paths, environment, one file)
Owner: В«Р”Р°, РЅРµ РїСЂРѕР±Р»РµРјР° С‡С‚Рѕ & rg --files РїСЂРѕР№РґРµС‚, РїРѕС‡РµРјСѓ РµС‰Рµ Р·Р°РїСЂРµС‰РµРЅС‹ РёСЃРєР°С‚РµР»Рё - РїСѓС‚Рё Рё РѕРєСЂСѓР¶РµРЅРёРµ, РІР°Р»РёС‚СЃСЏ РјРѕСЂРµ РѕС€РёР±РѕРєВ» в†’ В«РЎРѕРІРµСЂС€РµРЅРЅРѕ РІРµСЂРЅРѕВ». AUDIT FIRST (`experiments/2026-10-06_constitution-dir-head/audit-path-env.ts`, 24 commands Г— 3 paths): PATH toolchain lookups and the cmd environment already ran (`where`, `which`, `where /r`, `echo %PATH%`, `set`, `set PATH`, `cmd /c set`, `Test-Path`, `attrib`, `icacls`), while their PowerShell equivalents and the targeted `dir`/`type` were refused вЂ” `Get-Item <path>`, `Resolve-Path <path>`, `Get-ChildItem env:`, `Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath <file>`, `dir /b <file>`, `dir <dir>`, `type <file>`. The audit ALSO corrected my own proposal: I claimed `cat` passes because it does NOT resolve вЂ” `where cat` / `where ls` showed the project's own shims (`bin\cat.exe`, `bin\ls.exe`), so the pass is the resolve-escape working as designed and `cat` was NOT touched. Fix: `targetedQuery(firstToken, tokens)` вЂ” a named subject runs (`dir`/`type`/`Get-Item`/`Resolve-Path` need a non-flag argument; `Get-ChildItem` needs `env:` or `-LiteralPath`), while a wildcard argument or a recursive flag turns the query back into a walk; `enumerationBlock` consults it BEFORE the native/known decision, and all three call sites pass their tokens (guard loop, guard tail, AST). Still refused: bare `dir`, `dir /b`, `dir /s`, `type`, `type *.txt`, bare `Get-ChildItem`, `tree`, `rg --files`. Oracle: probe 23 cases Г— 3 paths ALL MATCH (20261006T030635Z_4dc161b7); tests 69 pass/0 fail вЂ” the one red was the OLD requirement pinned at `constitution.test.ts:230` (`type file.txt` in the blocked list), moved with its provenance, and its lying comments (В«ls does NOT exist on native WindowsВ») corrected to the measured shims. Descriptions moved in the SAME change (bash/cmd/powershell/run): В«the WALK is hard-blocked; a query that NAMES its subject is notВ», both lists spelled out. Evidence: audit before (20261006T030154Z_62592c2c) в†’ after (20261006T030545Z_4076cfa2); probe+tests 64/0 (20261006T030635Z_ef9f1486); 69/0 (20261006T030659Z_9616a06c); _build.ps1 (20261006T030708Z_b54ef195).

## [2026-10-06] constitution: any executable outside the known tools is crash-prone вЂ” safe launch via cmd_runner (unknown-app inversion)

Owner: В«Р›СЋР±РѕР№ СЌРєР·РµС€РЅРёРє РєСЂРѕРјРµ РёР·РІРµСЃС‚РЅС‹С… С‚СѓР»РѕРІ РёР· Р±РёРЅР° - crash prone.В» в†’ В«РЎС‚Р°РЅРґР°СЂС‚РЅРѕ - РµСЃР»Рё СЌС‚РѕС‚ Р°РїРї РЅРµ РёР·РІРµСЃС‚РµРЅ РЅР°Рј Рё РЅРµ РїСЂРѕС€РµР» С‚РµСЃС‚С‹ - С‚Рѕ Р±РµР·РѕРїР°СЃРЅС‹Р№ Р·Р°РїСѓСЃРє.В» Motive, verbatim: В«Р°РіРµРЅС‚ РЅР°РїРёСЃР°Р» РїСЂРёР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёРµ, Р·Р°РїСѓСЃС‚РёР» - РѕРЅРѕ Р·Р°РІРёСЃР»Рѕ - РІСЃРµВ» В· В«С‚Р°Рє РєР°Рє TUI Р·Р°РІРёСЃР»Р° С‚Рѕ Рё Р»РѕРіРѕРІ РЅРёРєР°РєРёС…В». Approved scope (AskUser): known = `bin/**` utilities + `git`/`python`/`node`/`pwsh`/`cmd`; area = `run` tool + shell tools.

Fix: `shell-constitution.ts` вЂ” `KNOWN_TOOLS` (bin/** + system minimum), `NON_APP_HEADS` (shell-sets-seeded builtins), `headTokens()` (a quoted head is ONE token вЂ” `"C:\Program Files\вЂ¦\pwsh.exe"` used to tear at the space), `isUnknownAppToken()` (only a FILE вЂ” a path or `.exe/.cmd/.bat/.com/.ps1` вЂ” can be an app; a bare word keeps the old permission flow), `containsUnknownApp()`; `shouldRouteViaCmdRunner` = crash-prone в€Є unknown-file. Descriptions moved in the same change (run/cmd/bash/powershell .txt); tests: +9 cases in `shell-constitution.test.ts`.

Measured journey, recorded as design evidence: a first pass wrapped ANY unrecognized word вЂ” 21 fail / 195 across bash+cmd+exec-contract (permission asks lost `mytool`/`Get-Date foo`; truncation lost on `fill()`'s `bun.exe -e`; timeout-kill lost on `ping -n 60`). Narrowing to files + quoted-token fix в†’ 4 fail; keeping paths to the KNOWN crash-prone runners unwrapped (`C:\вЂ¦\bun.exe`) в†’ 0. Final: 196 tests / 194 pass / 2 skip / 0 fail (20261006T102430Z_615a2190); mutation check (logic disabled) в†’ 4 fail, so the new cases are fallible. Residual: paths to crash-prone runners stay unwrapped (a wrapped session returns session output, not the command's own stream вЂ” truncation contract), and `start <app>` / `call` can still carry a bare app inside an argument.

Evidence: red-first mutation 20261006T100638Z_5ab07b83 (22 pass/4 fail); narrowed run 20261006T101653Z_12ca83b1 (193 pass, 1 env-flake SQLITE_CANTOPEN in .temp\test); isolated flake proof `shell-exec-contract` 35/0 (20261006T101950Z_be466caf); clean-suite green 20261006T102430Z_615a2190; `_build.ps1` 20261006T102052Z_9be2cc40 в†’ `.temp/test/ cleaned`, 10.0.1200 smoke PASS, exit 0. []).map is not a function") traced to routes/session/index.tsx:3218 (Edit renderer) and the sibling reduce at :3261: the renderer mapped state.input.files directly, and state.input is the model's RAW call - session/processor.ts:946 writes value.input into the part on `tool-call`, before any schema decode - so a model-emitted `files` that was not an array threw INSIDE the Solid render (a fatal TUI error via error-component, not a tool failure). Fix: both derivations move to the sibling module routes/session/edit-input.ts#editInputSummary (extraction pattern of text-segments/deferred-mount), which gates on Array.isArray(input.files) and reads elements as f?.filePath - malformed input degrades to an empty summary and never throws; the component holds no .map/.reduce over raw input anymore. [2026-10-13T11:45Z] org-queue contract repair - fencing + recorded wake effects + delegator verdicts (plan 2026-10-08_org-fencing-and-effects; scripts/org-genesis/{org.py,orgd.py,Protocol.md} + new test_queue_contract.py). FENCING: heartbeat/report/done/escalate now require --epoch N (the epoch the claim won); a stale epoch is refused naming the current holder, so a worker whose lease was taken over can no longer write DONE; claim also refuses VERIFIED/CANCELLED.
